name: HumanAIEdit AI Humanizer
author: fostjiny

sections.description:
HumanAIEdit AI Humanizer adds a HumanAIEdit sidebar to the WordPress block editor, so authors can improve an AI-assisted draft without leaving the post editor.

Use this plugin when you want to:

  • Use HumanAIEdit from the WordPress editor sidebar.
  • Rewrite the current post or page draft with your HumanAIEdit account.
  • Choose Auto Match or a public HumanAIEdit writing style.
  • Preview the rewritten draft before changing your WordPress content.
  • Replace the current draft only after you confirm.
  • Copy the result if you prefer to paste manually.

The plugin requires a HumanAIEdit account. HumanAIEdit plans, credits, usage limits, billing, and AI rewriting happen in HumanAIEdit.

Create or open your account at https://humanaiedit.com.

Terms of Service: https://humanaiedit.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://humanaiedit.com/privacy-policy

This plugin does not automatically publish posts, does not save WordPress drafts for you, and does not add public backlinks, badges, footer links, or credit links to your site.

This plugin is designed for natural rewriting and editing. It does not promise any specific result from third-party detector tools.

External Services

This plugin connects to HumanAIEdit, an external SaaS service at https://humanaiedit.com.

HumanAIEdit is used to authenticate your account, check your plan and credits, and rewrite the current WordPress draft content when you click the humanize button.

Data sent to HumanAIEdit:

  • The current draft title.
  • The current draft content.
  • The WordPress site URL.
  • The WordPress post ID and post type.
  • The selected writing style.
  • The plugin version.
  • The HumanAIEdit site connection token stored in WordPress after you authorize the site.

HumanAIEdit returns the rewritten text, account plan, remaining credits, and public writing style information.

HumanAIEdit Terms of Service: https://humanaiedit.com/terms-of-service
HumanAIEdit Privacy Policy: https://humanaiedit.com/privacy-policy

Privacy

This plugin sends draft content to HumanAIEdit only when an editor clicks Humanize draft. It does not send visitor analytics, comments, form submissions, customer data, or unrelated WordPress data to HumanAIEdit.

If an editor manually places sensitive information in a draft and clicks Humanize draft, that draft content is sent to HumanAIEdit for rewriting.

The plugin does not load visitor-facing tracking scripts and does not inject public external links.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open a post or page in the WordPress block editor.
  3. Open the HumanAIEdit sidebar.
  4. Click Use HumanAIEdit.
  5. Sign in or create a HumanAIEdit account.
  6. Authorize the current WordPress site.
  7. Return to WordPress and humanize a draft from the sidebar.
sections.faq:
Do I need a HumanAIEdit account?

Yes. HumanAIEdit handles account access, plans, credits, billing, and AI rewriting.

Do I need to connect every time?

No. The first authorization uses a short-lived code to create a long-lived site token. After that, the plugin uses the saved site token until you disconnect, the token is revoked, or a security check requires a new authorization.

Does this plugin publish posts automatically?

No. The plugin only previews rewritten text and can replace the current editor draft after you click Replace draft. You still choose when to save, update, or publish in WordPress.

Does this plugin store my full HumanAIEdit token in the admin UI?

No. The plugin stores the token in WordPress options and only displays a short suffix in settings.

Does this plugin guarantee detector results?

No. HumanAIEdit focuses on natural, editable rewriting. It does not guarantee any AI detector result.
